cover.desc: Full color, cold institutional palette with one warm figure. A school assembly hall seen from high and behind: rows of pale uniformed backs, flat geometric shadow shapes, everything drained to grey-blue and bone. One figure stands alone at the end of a row in the middle distance, dark-haired, small, head slightly lowered — the only warm-lit thing in the frame, a thin amber window light falling across him. Far away at the front, a lectern and a sheet of paper. Colored lineart, hard-edged shadows, enormous negative space, the composition making him tiny and specific.

panels.bg: school exterior, Monday morning, clear cold light, students crossing the yard, tone-washed
panels.action: Monday. Nothing has gone wrong yet.

dialogue.text: Monday.
Two people know. Three if you count Kirisu. Four with Mizusawa.
Four is a lot. Four has been fine for a week.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: walking backwards, arms full of folders

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: half-lidded, carrying most of the folders

panels.action: Gen has been given a job and is coping badly.

dialogue.text: Assembly at ten. Full year. They only do full year for bad news.
Or sports day.
It is NOT sports day. I checked. I asked three people.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: immaculate, gloves on, moving fast

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: half-running to keep up, tablet out

panels.action: Kanade has been in the staff wing since half seven.

dialogue.text: It's a safety announcement. That's all anyone's saying.
After a thread loss on a floor that's closed?
...Yes. When you say it like that.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: calculating hard behind a pleasant face

panels.action: She runs the possibilities and none of them are good.

dialogue.text: If they name the floor, they name the roster.
If they name the roster, they name him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping dead

panels.action: She changes direction mid-corridor.

dialogue.text: I need Nabari before ten.
He's not seeing anyone. Kanade—
Then he can not-see me in person.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: grey with tiredness, standing behind his desk

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the doorway, composed, cold

panels.bg: supervisor's office, morning light, files, tone-washed
panels.action: He has both forms on the desk in front of him and has had them since Friday.

dialogue.text: Ariake. Count of one. Smell.
Yes, sir.
On a training floor. Layer nine.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: not angry, which is worse
chars.pose: setting the forms down side by side

panels.action: He puts the two forms down next to each other.

dialogue.text: Layer nine has taken one thread in nine years.
It took two in one night. From my two best students.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: saying nothing, entirely still

panels.action: She does not lie again. She simply does not speak.

dialogue.text: Anything I say now makes it worse for him.
So say nothing. Stand here and say nothing.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: sitting down heavily, rubbing his face

panels.action: He tells her what is going to happen, because he is not cruel, only tired.

dialogue.text: Head of faculty is doing the assembly. Not me.
He's going to use the numbers. He thinks it'll frighten them off the tower.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the first crack in the composure

panels.action: She understands the shape of it before he finishes.

dialogue.text: With names, sir?
I asked him not to.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: half-lidded, sitting mid-row
chars.pose: seated in a hall of four hundred

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: beside him, whispering loudly

panels.bg: assembly hall, rows of students, high windows, tone-washed
panels.action: Ten o'clock. Four hundred people in a hall.

dialogue.text: Told you. Bad news face. Look at him. That's a bad news face.
That's his only face.
Fair.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: >_<, whispering behind his hand, tiny

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: dot eyes, blank, tiny

panels.action: The last comedy beat before the chapter turns.

dialogue.text: If it's sports day I'm doing the relay and you're doing the relay.
I'm not doing the relay.
YOU'RE DOING THE RELAY.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting three rows ahead, rigid
chars.pose: hands flat on her knees, staring at the lectern

panels.action: Kanade is three rows in front of him and cannot turn around.

dialogue.text: Three rows. If I turn round now, four hundred people watch me do it.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: standing at the side of the stage, folder under his arm, not looking at anyone

panels.action: Nabari stands at the side of the stage and looks at the floor.

dialogue.text: I asked him not to.
That's the whole of what I did. I asked, and then I stood here.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, bored, entirely unprepared

panels.action: He is thinking about Saturday.

dialogue.text: Rice. Three and a half cups, under protest.
She'll bring the notebook. She brings it every week now.

chars.name: announcer
chars.expression: middle-aged, formal, entirely well-meaning
chars.pose: at a lectern with a sheet of paper

panels.bg: assembly hall stage, microphone, banner, tone-washed
panels.action: The head of faculty is a decent man giving a safety talk.

dialogue.text: Two students lost threads this term on unauthorised dives.
I'm going to read what that actually means, because posters don't work.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: eyes closing briefly

panels.action: She knows exactly what is about to happen and there is nothing she can do from a chair.

dialogue.text: Don't. Please don't. Please don't do it with the paper in your hand.

chars.name: announcer
chars.expression: reading from the form, kindly, disastrously

panels.action: He reads the first one and it is almost nothing.

dialogue.text: Student A. Second year. Count of one. Loss of smell.
One dive. That is what one dive costs.

chars.name: announcer
chars.expression: turning the page

panels.action: He turns to the second form.

dialogue.text: Student B. Second year. Also on that dive.
Cumulative count of ten.

panels.bg: wide shot of the whole assembly hall from the stage, four hundred faces, absolutely still, tone-washed
panels.action: Four hundred people make the same small sound at once.

dialogue.text: Ten?
Nobody's on ten. Kirisu-senpai's on twelve and he's twenty.

chars.name: announcer
chars.expression: reading the list, entirely sincere, doing enormous harm

panels.action: He reads the whole list out. It takes eleven seconds.

dialogue.text: Taste. Smell. Heat. Cold. Most sensation of pain.
Grip. Weather. Balance in the dark. Startle response.
And, as of Thursday, directional hearing.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: absolutely nothing on his face

panels.action: He does not move at all.

dialogue.text: That's the whole list.
It's shorter out loud than I thought it would be.
Nobody in this hall knows it's me.
That lasts about four minutes.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: grinning, turning to Kou, about to make a joke

panels.action: Gen turns to make a joke about it, because that is what he does with everything.

dialogue.text: Ten. Imagine being that stupid, mate. Who even—
Ten threads. You'd have to be diving every week for a year.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: the sentence dying, face changing

panels.action: He is looking at his best friend's face while he says it.

dialogue.text: Directional hearing. Thursday.
He turned the wrong way in the yard on Friday.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: looking straight ahead, not at Gen

panels.action: Kou does not look at him. That is the confirmation.

dialogue.text: ...Kou.
Not here.
Sorry. Sorry — not here. Right.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing up in the middle of an assembly
chars.pose: on her feet, three rows forward, alone

panels.bg: assembly hall, four hundred seated students, one standing figure, tone-washed
panels.action: First in the year stands up in the middle of the head of faculty's speech.

dialogue.text: —which is why the closure of layer thirty-three is not negotia—
...Ariake-san?

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the assembly voice, immaculate, and underneath it fury
chars.pose: chin level, hands at her sides

panels.action: She uses the voice four hundred people trust.

dialogue.text: Sir. May I ask a question about the figures?
...Of course.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: cool, precise, publicly reasonable

panels.action: She does the only thing she can do from the floor of a hall.

dialogue.text: Does the report say where the divers were standing?
I'm sorry?
The tower charges whoever holds the line. It's in the Kirisu paper.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not raising her voice at all

panels.action: She lands it in front of four hundred people without naming anybody.

dialogue.text: So a count of ten doesn't mean somebody was reckless.
It means somebody stood in front, ten times, on purpose.

panels.bg: wide of the hall, four hundred students, absolute silence, one girl standing, tone-washed
panels.action: Nobody says anything for a while.

dialogue.text: ...That is a fair point, Ariake-san. Thank you. Please sit down.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting down, hands shaking very slightly

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: beside her, staring straight ahead

panels.action: She sits down. Riko does not look at her.

dialogue.text: You just defended a boy you've never been seen speaking to.
I defended a statistic.
Kanade. Everyone in this hall is doing arithmetic.

chars.name: student_a
chars.expression: turning to whisper

chars.name: student_b
chars.expression: eyes going to the back of the hall

panels.action: Four hundred people begin the arithmetic.

dialogue.text: Second year. On the Thursday roster.
There were three names on that roster.
One of them has a blank pin.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: aware of every single one of them, giving nothing

panels.action: He can feel the room turning without being able to tell where any of it is coming from.

dialogue.text: Somebody's said my name. Two rows back, or four.
I can't tell which. That's funny, actually. That's genuinely funny.

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: turning round in her seat, delighted and appalled at once

panels.action: Amasaki says it out loud, in the ordinary way she says everything.

dialogue.text: Hazama-kun. It's you, isn't it.
The blank pin. All this time. You've been diving.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face, the shrug, the thing he has always done

panels.action: He does the only thing he has ever done in this room.

dialogue.text: Yeah. Fair.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking out of a hall that is entirely silent

panels.bg: assembly hall aisle, four hundred faces turning to follow him, high windows, tone-washed
panels.action: He walks out. Nobody stops him. Four hundred people watch him do it.

dialogue.text: Eleven rows. Then the door.
Don't go faster. If you go faster it's a thing.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible, silhouette
chars.pose: one small dark figure in a lit doorway at the end of a long hall

panels.bg: flat tone field, solid silhouette in a bright doorway, rows of seated shapes
panels.action: The shape four hundred people see.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: half out of her seat, stopping herself
chars.pose: gripping the chair back in front

panels.action: She gets halfway up and Riko's hand lands on her wrist.

dialogue.text: Not in front of them.
Riko.
You go now and it's a headline. Give it four minutes.
He walked out on his own and the whole hall watched.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting back down, face perfect, eyes wrong

panels.action: She sits back down and holds the shopkeeper face for four minutes.

dialogue.text: He's not going to catch him.
Four minutes.
He has walked out of every room in this building alone for two years.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: standing up, folders spilling, not caring

panels.action: Gen does not give it four minutes.

dialogue.text: Excuse me. Sorry. Excuse me.
Ōkubo, sit down—
No.
Sorry, that's my friend, I need to — thank you, sorry.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting on a stair, entirely calm
chars.pose: on the steps of an empty stairwell, elbows on knees

panels.bg: back stairwell, cold light through a high window, tone-washed
panels.action: He is not upset. That is the problem.

dialogue.text: It's fine. It was always going to come out.
Four hundred people know a number. The number was already true.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: arriving at speed, out of breath, furious

panels.action: Gen arrives like weather.

dialogue.text: Two years.
Gen—
TWO YEARS. I asked you every Saturday for two years.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: not angry underneath — devastated

panels.action: The anger falls off almost immediately, which is worse.

dialogue.text: You said stocktake. You said it was stocktake.
It was easier.
For who?

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not looking up, giving the true answer

panels.action: He gives him the honest answer, which he owes him.

dialogue.text: For me.
You'd have forgiven it in four seconds and I'd have had to watch you do it.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: hearing exactly what that means

panels.action: Gen understands it completely and it takes about a second.

dialogue.text: ...You thought that was the bad part.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: sitting down heavily on the step below him

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not moving

panels.action: Gen sits down on the step below and stays there.

dialogue.text: Right. Okay. New rule.
Gen.
New rule, I'm doing the rule. Shut up.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: counting on his fingers, entirely serious

panels.action: He makes a rule the way he makes everything: badly, and completely.

dialogue.text: One. I'm still asking on Saturdays.
Two. You still say no. That bit was always fine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: something going in his face that he cannot stop

panels.action: This is the panel where he nearly goes.

dialogue.text: He's not going to make me say anything.
He's just going to keep asking. He's going to keep asking anyway.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: looking anywhere else, giving him the room
chars.pose: elbows on knees, staring at the wall

panels.action: Gen looks at the wall for a while, which is the kindest thing he has ever done.

dialogue.text: Three. You tell me the next one. Not the hall. Me.
...All right.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: brightening back up at speed

panels.action: He recovers in about four seconds, exactly as advertised.

dialogue.text: Also you're an idiot and Ariake-san stood up in an ASSEMBLY for you.
She did what?

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking a corridor with everybody looking at her

panels.bg: school corridor at lunch, students clustered and staring, tone-washed
panels.action: The building has decided what it thinks by lunchtime.

dialogue.text: She stood up for the blank pin.
First in the year. In front of the head of faculty.
Let them. Let all of them.

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: stepping into her path, genuinely curious, not cruel

panels.action: Amasaki asks the question the whole building is asking.

dialogue.text: Ariake-san. Are you two friends?
Amasaki-san.
Because nobody's ever seen you speak to him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the committee smile arriving on schedule

panels.action: The smile comes up automatically, and then she stops it.

dialogue.text: Two years of this face. It has worked every single time.
He does it too. He does it in that hall and everybody laughs.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: dropping the smile entirely, in a corridor, in daylight

panels.action: She takes the face off in front of everyone.

dialogue.text: We dive together. Every Thursday. For fourteen months.
...You what?

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: calm, absolutely steady, ruining her own reputation on purpose

panels.action: She says it plainly, in a corridor, where anybody can hear.

dialogue.text: He's the best diver in this building.
And you have all been laughing at him for two years.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: hauling her into an empty classroom by the sleeve
chars.pose: pulling the door shut behind them

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: letting herself be pulled

panels.bg: empty classroom, midday light, dust in the air, tone-washed
panels.action: Riko gets her into an empty room before the corridor finishes exploding.

dialogue.text: You've just ended your year.
Probably.
The stream. The recommendation. All of it.
Four hundred people heard you say it.
I counted about four hundred, yes.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting on a desk, suddenly very tired

panels.action: The composure comes off all at once now the door is shut.

dialogue.text: They read his list out. In a hall. Off a piece of paper.
Ten things, Riko. In eleven seconds. Like a shopping list.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: quiet, sitting down opposite her

panels.action: Riko does not manage her. She has stopped doing that.

dialogue.text: And you couldn't do anything from a chair.
No.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hands over her face for exactly one panel

panels.action: One panel. She takes one panel and then she stops.

dialogue.text: Don't. I'm still furious with you.
One minute. I'm allowed one minute.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: handing her a handkerchief without comment

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking it

panels.action: Riko hands her a handkerchief and says something else entirely.

dialogue.text: Is it Saturday tomorrow?
...Yes.
Then go and be somewhere useful.
Thank you.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the school gate, bag over one shoulder
chars.pose: walking out into low afternoon light

panels.bg: school gate, late afternoon, long shadows, students in the distance, tone-washed
panels.action: Four o'clock. He leaves through the front, which he has never once done.

dialogue.text: The back way is eight minutes shorter.
I've used it for two years so nobody had to look at me.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: leaning on the gatepost, waiting, one eye up

panels.action: PIKE is on the gatepost and has been for an hour.

dialogue.text: Heard they did the list.
They did the list.
They did mine in my second year. Different hall. Same paper.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: grinning, and it does not reach anything

panels.action: He does the bit, and for once you can see the join.

dialogue.text: Everyone's very kind for about a week.
Then you're the boy with the number. That's the whole personality.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: asking the question

panels.action: Kou asks him the only useful question available.

dialogue.text: How do you get out of it?
You don't. You get one or two people who knew you before it.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: pointing down the road with his chin

panels.action: He nods down the road.

dialogue.text: You've got two. One of them's been standing there for ten minutes.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing at the corner with two shopping bags

panels.bg: street corner near the school, late afternoon, tone-washed
panels.action: She is at the corner with the shopping, on a Friday, which is not a rota day.

dialogue.text: It's Friday.
I'm aware of the day, Ariake. I own a calendar.
...That's mine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: taking one of the bags without asking

panels.action: He takes the heavier bag. Neither of them mentions the hall.

dialogue.text: I'm not going to say anything about this morning.
Good.
I'm going to say one thing and then nothing.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: furious on his behalf and keeping it entirely level
chars.pose: looking straight ahead as they walk

panels.action: The one thing.

dialogue.text: They read it like it was a receipt.
It's not a receipt. I was standing behind every one of them.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: walking, saying nothing for a while

panels.action: He does not answer for half a street.

dialogue.text: You stood up.
I asked a question about figures.
Ariake.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: going red at the ears, staring resolutely forward

panels.action: She does not look at him.

dialogue.text: You'd have said no.
That's mine as well.
I know. It's a very good line.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: cooking, sleeves up

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on the counter, spoon in hand

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: sitting on the floor holding a bowl, hugely pleased with himself

panels.bg: apartment kitchen, evening, crowded, warm light, tone-washed
panels.action: Gen has invited himself and nobody has told him not to.

dialogue.text: So this is the thing. On Saturdays. This is the thing.
It's Friday.
It's a FRIDAY THING NOW. I'm in it.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: >_<, delighted, tiny

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: dot eyes, deadpan, tiny

panels.action: Register switch. The room is allowed to be funny again.

dialogue.text: ARIAKE-SAN IS ON THE COUNTER LIKE SHE LIVES HERE.
I have a designated position.
SHE HAS A DESIGNATED POSITION.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: suddenly quieter, holding the bowl in both hands

panels.action: Gen goes quiet for exactly one panel.

dialogue.text: Can he taste this?
No.
Right. So I'll say it, then. It's really good.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: back turned, stopping for a second at the stove

panels.action: He has to stand still for a second.

dialogue.text: Two people now.
Two people describing things at me. In one kitchen.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: in the doorway with her coat on, flat

panels.action: Shizu comes home to three people in her kitchen.

dialogue.text: There are people on my floor.
There are.
Mm.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: on the balcony, elbows on the rail

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: beside him, two mugs, offering one

panels.bg: apartment balcony, night, city lights low and scattered, tone-washed
panels.action: Gen has gone home. It is half eleven.

dialogue.text: It's very hot. Almost too hot to hold.
You always say that.
It's always true. I'm not going to lie about tea.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: quiet, finally saying it

panels.action: He says the thing he has not said all day.

dialogue.text: It wasn't the list.
No?
It was hearing it in that voice. Like a delivery note.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: listening, not fixing anything

panels.action: She does not fix it. She has learned that much.

dialogue.text: Ten things I used to have, read out by a man doing his job.
And I sat there and did the face.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: opening the notebook on the rail
chars.pose: flattening the page with one hand

panels.action: She puts the notebook on the rail and opens it.

dialogue.text: Then we'll do it properly. In the right voice.
Ariake—
Sit down. This takes a while.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading from the notebook, entirely matter-of-fact
chars.pose: sitting on the balcony floor beside him, book on her knees

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting against the wall, eyes closed

panels.bg: balcony floor at night, warm light from the kitchen door, tone-washed
panels.action: She reads his own list back to him in the voice she uses for tea.

dialogue.text: One. Taste. Melon bread — sweet, crisp on the top.
Two. Smell. Rain on hot pavement, which you said was the best one.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: steady, turning a page

panels.action: She goes through all ten. It takes considerably longer than eleven seconds.

dialogue.text: Three. Heat. A bath you have to get into slowly.
Four. Cold. The bit where your ears hurt and then stop.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes still closed, face finally not doing anything at all

panels.bg: flat tone, warm edge light, tone-washed
panels.action: He does not do the mild face. He does not do anything.

dialogue.text: This is the same list.
It's the same ten things and it isn't the same list at all.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reaching the end, quieter

panels.bg: notebook, lamp light from the doorway, tone-washed
panels.action: The last one.

dialogue.text: Ten. Directional hearing.
That one's mine. I haven't written it up yet.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes open, looking at her

panels.action: He asks, and it is the only thing he asks for in eight chapters.

dialogue.text: Do it now.
There's a cat behind us. Left, about six metres, on the wall.
Same one. Still winning.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: quiet, almost smiling

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: closing the notebook

panels.bg: balcony at night, kitchen light behind them, tone-washed
panels.action: They stay out there a while.

dialogue.text: Thursday.
Thursday.
And Saturday.
And I'm still on front.
We'll talk about it.
We won't.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing, coat on, at the door

panels.action: She leaves at midnight and forgets something on purpose.

dialogue.text: I've left the notebook.
You've left it on the rail.
Yes. Look after it.
Goodnight, Ariake.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a notebook open on a balcony rail at night, a new line being added in terrible handwriting under a neat precise one, tone-washed
panels.action: He writes in her book, which he has never done.

dialogue.text: Goodnight, Hazama.
Assembly hall — sounded like a delivery note. (Do not keep.)

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: alone in his office at night, two forms in front of him

panels.bg: supervisor's office at night, one lamp, wall chart, tone-washed
panels.action: Across the building, Nabari is still at his desk.

dialogue.text: Every year there's one I could stop.
This year there are two, and they're the same two.

panels.bg: flat tone field, an official form on a desk, a printed header and a stamp, tone-washed
panels.action: The form he has been filling in since eight o'clock.

dialogue.text: APPLICATION: LAYER 33 — SUPERVISED CLEARANCE ATTEMPT
DIVERS: ARIAKE K. / HAZAMA K. / KIRISU W.
